ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobes to 25% low-intensity black pixels defining the perimeter and peduncle area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous zones occupy the interior of both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation forms a solid boundary along the trailing and leading edges, with a thick vertical bifurcating band at the central peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior pixel angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) with amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels distributed continuously along the trailing edge from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge resulting in a tapered sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular low-intensity pixel clusters localized primarily in the lower-central region of both lobes and scattered across the white interior of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent dark linear pixel disruptions including a long, continuous diagonal rake mark on the upper right lobe and several shorter, intersecting linear marks on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized dark pigmentation blotches and scarring concentrated around the central fluke-to-peduncle transition zone.
